title: Rickover and the Atomic Energy Commission

tellings.quote: Well, first of all, the Atomic Energy Commission wasn't under Department of Energy till 76

plain: The Atomic Energy Commission, the government body that ran America's atomic work after the war, did not come under the Department of Energy until 1976, according to John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy. He says this while talking about Hyman Rickover, and a book titled Underway My Way is credited alongside it. The point bears on which agency was responsible for what in those years.
